title: Multidimensional Poverty
definition: Multidimensional poverty measures deprivation across multiple simultaneous indicators—such as health, education, and standard of living—rather than relying solely on income or consumption expenditure.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for General Studies Paper II (Welfare schemes, poverty, development issues) and Paper III (Inclusive growth, economic development), as well as Prelims questions on global indices and NITI Aayog reports.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Multidimensional Poverty.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of economic development and inclusive growth
